overview: City Councilor Nicole Morell reviewed her recent policy efforts and upcoming council priorities, followed by an interview with the co-owners of Reimagine gym.

items.title: City Council Reflections and Priorities
items.summary: City Councilor Nicole Morell highlighted her advocacy for emergency rental assistance, tree and diversity budget increases, sustainable transportation, and charter review.

items.title: Interview with Reimagine Owners
items.summary: Co-owners Teresa Racicot and Mike Denton shared the background, mission, and community focus of their inclusive fitness studio.
